$comment: Merge these two keys into styles/subjects.json. computer_science is the 11-12 counterpart of computer_science_k12 (same archetypes, no 'keep it short for young learners' constraint). electronics reuses the physics palette and archetype set — schematics behave like force diagrams.

computer_science.label: Computer Science (Grades 11-12)
computer_science.notes: Code panels use JetBrains Mono or Source Code Pro (the documented exception to the band font rule). Diagrams of architecture or data flow can be generated.

electronics.label: Electronics
electronics.notes: Circuit schematics must be extracted or drawn from an accurate source, never image-generated — component symbols and connection topology have to be exact. Otherwise identical to physics: same archetypes, same palette.
